articles.title: Russian strikes on Kyiv kill one, damage Dutch and Austrian embassies
articles.description: KYIV: A wave of daytime Russian strikes on Kyiv on Thursday (Nov 19) killed one person and damaged a historic cathedral as well as the embassies of Austria and the Netherlands, local authorities said.AFP reporters in the city heard loud explosions throughout …
